g.text: Every layer can contribute to the final category

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #617481

g.text: All 20,097 genes are evaluated at every layer—even after an earlier hold. Intermediate CTA = eligible so far.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #617481

g.text: *Final CTA requires every layer. Unsafe = research-policy exclusion, not proven toxicity. Neither includes insufficient or conflicting evidence.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #617481

g.text: Tumor admission: ≥2 native TPM/pTPM in any qualifying sample. DICE and cornea: optional coverage; observed positive evidence still applies.
